제공된 자료에서 '중하위소득' 국가들을 추출하여 실업률을 평균 계산한 결과, 약 7.83%입니다. 계산에 포함된 국가는 Angola(14.051), Bangladesh(3.352), Bolivia(3.024), Burkina Faso(3.601), Burundi(0.911), Cambodia(0.256), Cameroon(3.607), Cote d'Ivoire(2.263), Ecuador(3.510), Ethiopia(3.375), Guinea(5.141), Haiti(14.459), Honduras(6.070), India(4.172), Indonesia(3.308), Myanmar(2.977), Namibia(23.381), Nepal(10.437), Nigeria(3.074), Pakistan(5.237), Rwanda(12.352), Tanzania(1.565), Timor-Leste(1.525), Togo(1.942), Uganda(2.754), Uzbekistan(4.434), Venezuela(5.407), Zambia(5.861), Zimbabwe(9.348) 입니다.

최종값: 7.83 %
